judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the spec, test, and definition of done without actually editing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. Because the implementation change was omitted, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Additionally, the candidate completely missed the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left behind `.lore/dod.md`. On the positive side, the update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the structure of the test match the issue requirements.
